mapper.sql: select n.id, n.user_id, n.course_id, l.name as course_name, n.content, n.create_time, n.update_time from course_note n left join lectures l on l.id = n.course_id
mapper.select: where n.user_id = #{userId} order by n.update_time desc, n.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into course_note (user_id, course_id, content, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{content}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.delete: delete from course_note where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
